paperlight

Drag to turn the lantern.

Drag or use the arrow keys to turn the lantern. Press Space to toggle the light.

The shaded rim and tape areas stay intact. You can cut across the middle of each crease. Use the arrow keys to move the cursor. Press Space to begin drawing and Enter to cut. Press Enter to place a selected stamp or pattern. An open drawing shows a dotted join to confirm. Use the bracket keys to change its size. Escape cancels a stroke.

Make a paper lamp

  1. Cut your design. Draw a shape, place a stamp, or choose a pattern for a panel.
  2. Fold & light. Watch your creation come to life.
  3. Save or print. Save a picture, or print the template to cut and fold your lamp at home.
